restaurantName: The Tiffany Blue Box Cafe at Harrods
bio: Treat yourself to Afternoon Tea with a touch of glamour at The Tiffany Blue Box Cafe, housed inside London's iconic department store, Harrods.  Mirroring the famous flagship store in New York City, The Tiffany Blue Box Cafe exudes style and luxury, with its calming blue interior, plush booths and Tiffany jewels and motifs adorning the room.  Sitting delicately atop white and blue cake stands, their Tiffany Tea comprises a delectable array of sweets and savouries with a luxury twist. Tuck into dainty finger sandwiches, freshly baked scones and a stunning selection of patisseries, each one lovingly handcrafted and inspired by a different aspect of Tiffany & Co.'s heritage.  Harrods is located in the heart of an exclusive area of London, just a short walk away from Knightsbridge Tube station.
pageTitle: The Tiffany Blue Box Cafe at Harrods
